dictionary.先选择，再同步到 alex@example.com。: Choose what to sync to alex@example.com.
dictionary.原始本机数据会保留。加入家庭不会自动共享这些内容。: Your local originals stay here. Joining a family does not share this content.
dictionary.暂时保留在本机: Keep on this device for now
dictionary.一起做事，各自保留自己的空间。: Do things together. Keep your own space.
dictionary.你将成为家庭所有者。成员只会看到明确共享的内容。: You will be the family owner. Members only see content you explicitly share.
dictionary.由监护人创建并连接设备: A guardian creates it and connects a device
dictionary.选择已有目标，设定访问权限: Choose a goal and set access
dictionary.目前只有你。私人对话和目标不会自动出现在这里。: Just you for now. Private chats and goals are not shared automatically.
dictionary.对方接受后加入周末家庭。: Join 周末家庭 after accepting.
dictionary.邀请仅供指定邮箱使用。对方接受前，你可以随时撤销。: Only the specified email can use this invitation. You can revoke it before they accept.
dictionary.Alex 邀请你加入家庭空间。: Alex invited you to this family space.
dictionary.按每份内容的授权查看或编辑: View or edit as each item allows
dictionary.逐份内容授权，不随角色扩大: Granted per item, separate from role
dictionary.移除后停止新的共享访问。已离线设备会在获知撤权或授权到期后锁定。: Removal stops new shared access. Offline devices lock when notified or when access expires.
dictionary.由你建立监护关系并管理设备连接。: Become their guardian and manage device access.
dictionary.家庭管理员不自动成为监护人。连接设备不会开放儿童全部私人内容。: Family admins are not automatically guardians. Pairing does not give access to all private child content.
dictionary.请监护人核对设备与儿童身份: Ask the guardian to check this device and profile
dictionary.配对码失效后可重新获取。仅凭配对码不能取得监护人的会话。: Get a new code if it expires. A code alone cannot grant the guardian’s session.
dictionary.核对后，让小禾在自己的设备进入。: Check the details so 小禾 can sign in.
dictionary.只为儿童签发独立权限，设备不会获得你的账号凭证。: This creates a separate child session. Your account credentials stay private.
dictionary.撤销设备后，服务端拒绝刷新与同步；重新使用需要再次配对。: Revoking a device stops session renewal and sync. It must pair again to reconnect.
dictionary.此目标及预览中的任务: This goal and the previewed tasks
dictionary.共享同一份内容。家人的修改会同步给获授权成员，原件仍属于你。: Everyone works on the same content. Changes sync to authorized members. You keep ownership.
dictionary.整个会话和之后新增的消息: The entire chat, including future messages
dictionary.共享期间会持续显示标识。其他对话、个人密钥不会一起共享。: A shared label stays visible. Other chats and personal API keys stay private.
dictionary.提高工作交流能力 · 原件属于你: 提高工作交流能力 · Owned by you
dictionary.撤销共享只收回家庭访问权限，不删除你的原件。: Revoking sharing removes family access. Your original stays in your space.
dictionary.仍有效 · 到期前可离线编辑: Valid · You can edit until it expires
dictionary.重新联网后先核验当前权限，再提交待同步内容。: On reconnect, we check access before uploading pending changes.
dictionary.每周一起阅读 · 同一项任务: 每周一起阅读 · Same task
dictionary.确认前，两份修改均会保留。选择后仍需提交并取得云端确认。: Both versions stay until you confirm. Your choice still needs to sync and receive cloud confirmation.
dictionary.联网核验权限后才能继续: Connect to verify access and continue
dictionary.本地操作不能延长授权。核验失败时可以恢复你本人未提交的输入。: Local edits cannot extend access. If verification fails, you can recover your own pending input.
dictionary.这份内容不再向你共享。: This content is no longer shared with you.
dictionary.可恢复到私人草稿: Recover it as a private draft
dictionary.恢复仅包含你自己的未提交输入，不恢复已撤权的共享正文。: Recovery includes only your own pending input, not the shared content you lost access to.
dictionary.撤销设备会终止其后续会话刷新和同步访问。: Revoking a device stops future session renewal and sync access.
dictionary.仍有 2 项修改只保存在这台设备。: 2 changes are saved only on this device.
dictionary.退出后账号内容会隔离，不能由下一个账号读取或上传。: After sign-out, this account’s content stays isolated. Another account cannot read or upload it.
dictionary.周末家庭 · 选择新的所有者: 周末家庭 · Choose a new owner

dictionary.不会删除其他成员的私人内容。离线副本仍受既定授权期限约束。: Other members’ private content stays intact. Offline copies remain subject to the access expiry limit.
dictionary.你仍是周末家庭的唯一所有者。: You are still the only owner of 周末家庭.
